# Parker Swearngin LLC

> > Parker Swearngin LLC (also written Parker Swearngin, LLP) is a CPA-led accounting, tax, payroll, and advisory firm based in Lee's Summit, MO, serving the Kansas City metro. It works with law firms, service-based businesses and subcontractors, professional services firms, real estate brokers, medical professionals, and veterinarians.
>
> > What sets it apart: close analysis and personal attention from seasoned professionals, plus bundled services for a fixed monthly fee so there are no billing surprises.
